fields.title: Configuration is committed, pinned and explained

sections.Summary: The schema under `.schema/`, each corpus's descriptor, the overlay manifest, the site's navigation and the dependency pins all decide what this repository builds and publishes. Each of them is a tracked file. Each states an exact version where it states a version, and each has the comment a reviewer needs to judge the change. [yamllint] decides how the YAML itself is shaped, and `.yamllint` lists the few places this repository departs from it.
sections.Conformance checklist:
- [ ] `yamllint --strict .` passes.
- [ ] Every file the change touches is tracked, and contains no credential.
- [ ] Every dependency it adds names one exact version.
- [ ] `.github/dependabot.yml` names the directory that manifest sits in.
- [ ] Every new value has a comment giving its reason, and no comment restates its value.
- [ ] Any new `.yamllint` override gives the reason it departs from the baseline.
- [ ] `kac update --check --from ../../` passes in each corpus the change reaches.
